summary: Sprout Social, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its board authorized a $50 million share repurchase program. The program allows the company to buy back its Class A common stock (NASDAQ: SPT) in open-market or privately negotiated transactions. No specific price, premium, or duration was disclosed; execution details will be determined by management. The repurchase is discretionary and may be suspended or terminated at any time. The filing is a routine capital-return event, not a tender offer. Watch for subsequent 10b5-1 plans or actual repurchase disclosures for sizing and execution pace.
